components.name: Entry modes
components.description: Explicit Create/Join selection, not separate submitting controls.
components.css: .ds-modes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.ds-modes button{min-height:48px;padding:12px 20px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font:700 16px 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;padding-inline:8px;background:transparent;color:#dde6e4;border-color:var(--line,#425358)}.ds-modes button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#2d393b;border-color:var(--accent,#e6a65a);color:var(--accent,#e6a65a)}.ds-modes button:hover{background:#2e3c41}.ds-modes button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0bc7c;outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: The station palette and original engineer art remain the visual foundation. Redesign the entry and waiting-room composition, not the game's identity. This is a task-focused interface used on personal screens while friends organize a game; legible dark station surfaces keep it consistent with gameplay.
dos: Do preserve native form semantics, visible focus and reduced-motion alternatives.
Do use named/numbered colours alongside swatches.
donts: Do not turn the entry flow into a settings dashboard or require cosmetic choices before joining.
Do not imply a game has started when the user has only created a lobby.
